description: Drive a browser, make HTTP requests, and act AS the user on sites you're logged into (using your live browser session's cookies). Can drive the in-app headless browser OR switch a session to the real browser on the user's device. Optional pasted-cookie fallback.
skill_summary: How to drive a real, stateful browser tab (login flows, clicking, forms, JS-rendered content, screenshots) with the navigate→read→act loop — including the shared tab the user watches live — when to use http_request instead, and how the web_session_* cookie-replay tools act as the logged-in user on no-API sites (Facebook etc.). Load when a task needs a persistent, logged-in web page or to act as the user.

fields.label: Cookies (optional fallback)
fields.placeholder: Leave blank to use your live in-app browser login. Or paste {"c_user":"…","xs":"…"} / Netscape cookie-jar text to bring a login from an external browser.

fields.label: Login email / phone
fields.placeholder: The email or phone the agent logs in WITH (e.g. your Facebook login). Stored encrypted; never shown to the agent.

fields.label: Login password
fields.placeholder: Stored encrypted in the vault. The agent logs in with it server-side and never sees it.

fields.label: ZIP / postal code
fields.placeholder: Your area's ZIP, used to scope local searches (not secret — the agent may use it).
